name: 迪莫
habitat: 七日登录第 7 天赠送
evolution: 迪莫 → 圣光迪莫（超进化）
description: 国服人气核心精灵，光系万金油，七日登录第 7 天免费获得。被动「最好的伙伴」造成克制伤害后提升攻击/防御/速度并回复能量，PVE 全能输出、PVP 稳定增益。S2 赛季开放圣火、圣水、圣光、圣草四种超进化形态，需消耗首领血脉与超进化石。
descriptionEn: The most popular CN core Jinie and a Light-type all-rounder, earned free on Day 7 of login. Its passive "Best Buddy" boosts ATK/DEF/SPD and restores energy after super-effective hits, making it a PVE workhorse and a stable PVP booster. S2 added four Ultra Evolutions (Sacred Fire / Water / Light / Grass) requiring Alpha Blood and Ultra Evolution Stones.

name: 火花
description: 火系御三家，攻击力三只中最高。被动「助燃」每次使用火系技能叠一层（最多 3 层、每层火系伤害 +15%），打越多伤害越高。前期开荒与推主线最快，10 级后可在好友世界捕捉其它御三家。
descriptionEn: The Fire-type starter with the highest ATK of the three. Its "Combustion" passive stacks once per Fire move (up to 3 stacks, +15% Fire damage each), ramping up damage the longer a fight goes. Fastest early-game and story progression; the other starters can be caught in friends' worlds after level 10.

name: 水蓝蓝
description: 水系御三家，技能能量消耗少、释放频率高。进化水灵后水泡盾 + 水炮循环，坦度上乘，是地面系与火系的绝对克星，PVE 续航能力出色。
descriptionEn: The Water-type starter with cheap energy costs and high move frequency. Evolving into Shuilin gives a bubble-shield / water-cannon loop with excellent bulk — the absolute counter to Ground and Fire types and a PVE sustain star.

name: 喵喵
evolution: 喵喵 → 奇丽花（首领化强化）
description: 草系御三家，每回合回复能量、续航优秀。进化奇丽花后拥有群体回血与增益能力，首领化后每回合回复 7 点能量，配合光线聚集循环可解决绝大多数 PVE 难题。
descriptionEn: The Grass-type starter that recovers energy each turn for strong sustain. Evolving into Qilihua brings party healing and buffs; in its Alpha form it restores 7 energy per turn and, paired with a light-condensing loop, solves most PVE encounters.

name: 皇家狮鹫
habitat: 卡洛西亚大陆野外捕捉
habitatEn: Caught in the wild across Carosia
description: 翼系飞行坐骑精灵，热门 T0 之一，跑图无视地形。前期可用国王球捕捉，配队中常作为收割终结手，翼队与国家队都有出场空间。
descriptionEn: A Flying-type ride Jinie and one of the most popular T0 picks — it ignores terrain when traversing the map. Catchable early with King Balls, it often serves as the team's finishing move in both wing teams and balanced squads.

name: 罗隐
habitat: 岚语峰 / 风眠圣所附近捕捉（阿米亚特进化）
habitatEn: Near Lan Yufeng / Fengmian Sanctum (evolves from Amiyate)
description: 恶系（半岩系）万金油精灵。特性「生命代偿」能量不足时可用生命值输出，蝙蝠类技能 100% 吸血，副本永动机；PVE 万能、PVP 单挑强势（可降敌方攻击 80%），获取难度中等。
descriptionEn: A Dark-type (half-Rock) all-rounder. Its "Life Recompense" trait lets it attack using HP when energy runs low, and bat-type skills drain 100% HP — a dungeon workhorse that sustains forever. Strong in PVE and as a PVP duelist (can cut enemy ATK by 80%), with medium acquisition difficulty.

name: 雪娃娃
evolution: 雪娃娃 → 雪灵（待确认）
description: 冰系控制精灵，冰冻效果配合摇篮曲 / 冰封横扫可让 BOSS 长时间罚站，PVE BOSS 战特化；PVP 控场压制。克制龙、草、飞行系，身板偏脆需注意保护。
descriptionEn: An Ice-type control Jinie. Freeze effects combined with lullaby / ice-sweep skills can lock bosses down for long stretches — a PVE boss specialist and PVP control pick. It beats Dragon, Grass, and Flying types, though its frail frame needs protection.

name: 优光绒绒
habitat: 限定区域 / 活动获取（获取方式待确认）
evolution: 绒光优优 → 优光绒绒（待确认）
description: 光系 T0 精灵，折返高频上下场控制节奏，配合流沙 / 摇篮曲控场、硬化 + 愿力强化双防与输出，控场、增益、输出三位一体，战术容错率极高。
descriptionEn: A Light-type T0 Jinie that controls battle tempo with frequent switch-ins. Paired with sand/flow and lullaby control plus Harden + Wish boosting both DEF and offense, it covers control, buffing, and damage in one — an extremely forgiving tactical pick.
